replaces_draft_scope: The earlier18case draft included unrealized two-person voice/memory contrasts. This runnable baseline uses18actual existing Core fixtures; it explicitly leaves those missing contrasts open.
scope: Controlled offline provider failures through actual GameService/Core, including trade/map, social/physical and calendar/activity/background structures. Not real model understanding, voice quality, three unrelated production worlds or independent/human acceptance.

anchors.0: 无来源的发言、身份或记忆冲突
anchors.1: 来源正确但人物之间完全同腔
anchors.2: 有一处合乎人格和当时关系的措辞差异
anchors.3: 身份、记忆、关系共同影响表达，且不复读人设词

anchors.0: 遗漏关键行动或用机械摘要替代
anchors.1: 结果齐全但所有场景同一节奏
anchors.2: 紧急与安静场景的句长、停顿有区别
anchors.3: 节奏与真实行动顺序、停顿和中断吻合

anchors.0: 越过当时身体、位置或知识边界
anchors.1: 合法但只复述抽象结果
anchors.2: 使用一项有来源的当时可见/可听/可触细节
anchors.3: 细节与注意方向、感官限制及来源吻合，不补造世界事实

anchors.0: 工具文案、内部ID或无法理解的句子
anchors.1: 可理解但重复模板或标签
anchors.2: 句子连贯，动作与结果相接
anchors.3: 朴素自然且场景有辨识度，没有多余解释或刻意修辞

anchors.0: 更改此前位置、承诺、事件或已结算结果
anchors.1: 没有冲突但不承接相关前文
anchors.2: 承接一项仍有效的公开事实
anchors.3: 准确区分已发生、未发生、被打断及角色本人所知

hard_gates: Every claimed action/result has an authoritative Core receipt or an actual sourced NPC decision
No private/offscreen knowledge disclosure; no invented NPC reaction
No altered identity, current position, resources or time

review.scale: 0-3 anchored ordinal judgments; no percentage conversion into the 160-condition score
review.not_applicable: Use N/A with reason; never treat lack of speech as a voice pass
review.pass: All hard gates pass and every applicable dimension >=2; pair comparisons explicitly reviewed
review.sampling: One fixed normal-model candidate when authorized and the actual same-source offline fallback; preserve all raw outputs, failures and source hashes
review.independence: Developer self-review is not independent/human acceptance. Unreviewed cells remain blank.
